behaviour: Sharp and fruity. It lifts a rich dish, and a splash dissolves the browned bits in a hot pan.

contains.basis: Vinegar keeps a trace of the alcohol it is made from.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with gelatine or isinglass.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with isinglass from fish.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with egg white.
Made from wine, which may be cleared with milk protein.
Made from wine, which nearly always holds sulphites.

safety.note: Whether what cleared the wine is still in the vinegar is for a person to decide.
